title: Xiaoxi Help and Support
excerpt: Help with screenshot recognition, CSV imports, shared ledgers, iCloud synchronization and backup restoration.
content:
Basic bookkeeping works offline without a Xiaoxi account. Availability of 1.1.0 features depends on your installed version.

## Quick entries from screenshots

Select a WeChat or Alipay transaction screenshot, wait for on-device recognition, then check the amount, date, income/expense direction, category and notes before saving. Use a clear original screenshot including the merchant, amount and transaction time. Correct mistakes manually: a recognition suggestion is not a confirmed entry.

## Import and export

Choose a CSV file from 我的 → 导入账单 (Profile → Import transactions). Convert XLS / XLSX files to CSV first. On the confirmation screen, check mappings, dates, amounts and duplicates before importing. Confirmed and suspected duplicates are handled differently; review the result counts.

Before a large import or device change, save an independent file through 我的 → 完整数据备份 (Profile → Full data backup).

## Multiple ledgers and savings goals (1.1.0)

Open 我的 → 账本与共同攒钱 (Profile → Ledgers and Savings) to create family, couple or travel ledgers with separate statistics and budgets. You can also switch the current ledger from the bookkeeping screen.

Set a goal amount and date in ledger settings. Progress uses cumulative income minus expenses, excluding transfers. Deposits and withdrawals are bookkeeping entries only and do not move actual funds.

## Invite another member (1.1.0)

1. Each person uses an iPhone / iPad signed in to their own iCloud account.
2. Create a ledger to share. The default personal ledger holding migrated records remains private.
3. In ledger details, choose 通过 iCloud 邀请成员 (Invite through iCloud) and invite specific people through Apple's system interface.
4. After acceptance, allow the system to download data, then check the ledger and permissions.

Editors can change all transactions in a shared ledger. Offline edits sync after reconnecting. If two people change the same record, use the history to check the result. Ending sharing does not recall copies already saved by others.

## iCloud changes are not immediately visible

Check the Apple account, the app's iCloud permission, network connectivity and available storage. Open the app and check its synchronization status and errors. Synchronization is scheduled by the system, so a brief delay does not necessarily mean failure.

Export a backup before troubleshooting. Avoid repeatedly uninstalling, signing out of iCloud or clearing cloud data as a repair attempt. If the issue persists, contact support with your app version, OS version, steps and redacted error text.

## Synchronization versus versioned backups (1.1.0)

Synchronization maintains current data and can propagate edits and deletions. Versioned backups preserve independent snapshots from a particular time.

Open 我的 → iCloud 备份 (Profile → iCloud Backup) to back up now, see cloud versions and preview restoration. Automatic backup is off by default, runs at most once per day when enabled, and pauses at 20 backups. Manage older versions manually.

Check the restore preview. Personal data is replaced by the chosen version; actively shared ledgers remain, while shared ledgers in the backup become personal copies. A local rollback backup is saved first. Restoring is not a synchronization refresh command.

## Contact

Technical support and privacy requests: **modianwuhen@gmail.com**.

Include app version and build, device model, OS version, reproduction steps, expected behavior and actual behavior. Redact unnecessary names, counterparties, account details and amounts from screenshots. We do not need your Apple-account password. Do not post a complete ledger in public comments.
